fields.Participants: Trade Sales Rep, Logistics Coordinator, Contractor
fields.Trigger: Contractor places bulk order for job site delivery

workflows.name: Contractor Job Site Delivery Order Capture & Planning

Automation Opportunity: - Delivery scheduling auto-optimized from the route/dock/traffic data; real-time tracking auto-pushed to customer and store; POD auto-captured digitally
Controls: - CTL-451 (ensure controlled execution — Job Site Delivery Planning & Scheduling (PA-74.1).)
- operational: Trade Sales Representative sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Delivery-failure risk**: a delivery misses its window (traffic, access, scheduling), disrupting the customer/project; mitigated by the real-time tracking and the rescheduling protocol

- **Data-quality risk**: incomplete or inaccurate master data (pricing, inventory, customer) corrupts the workflow output; mitigated by the master-data governance (VS-29 / W291) and the periodic audit
System Touchpoints: - Order management (links to VS-08 / W536 unified order management, VS-60 / W2286 routing)
- Logistics/DC (links to VS-04 / W3 receiving, VS-04 / W52 fleet, VS-77 / material staging)
- Analytics/BI (links to VS-27 / W113)
Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the Trade Sales Representative role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.

steps.activity: Trade Sales Rep captures order: delivery address, site contact, access restrictions, required delivery window, special equipment needed (crane, boom truck)
Logistics Coordinator plans delivery: maps route to job site, verifies truck accessibility, coordinates with contractor for site preparation, schedules delivery within agreed window
System generates delivery order with job site details: GPS coordinates, site contact, special handling instructions; assigns to appropriate vehicle type; contractor receives SMS confirmation with ETA

steps.activity: Logistics Coordinator consolidates orders by region: groups 2–4 job site deliveries per route; sequences by proximity and time window; ensures total weight within vehicle capacity
System optimizes route considering: road restrictions, job site access times, unloading duration per site, driver hours of service compliance
DC Ops picks and loads multi-drop delivery: organizes by drop sequence; includes delivery manifest per drop; driver receives route plan via mobile app with GPS navigation

steps.activity: Logistics Coordinator identifies crane-required items: steel beams, large appliances, bulk cement; confirms site has suitable crane positioning, ground bearing capacity, overhead clearance
Coordinator books crane/boom truck from owned fleet or 3PL (PHP 15K–30K per delivery); schedules operator and rigger; confirms contractor has receiving personnel
Driver and crane operator execute delivery: position crane safely, lift materials to placement area; contractor signs delivery receipt; Logistics tracks actual vs. planned cost

steps.activity: Trade Sales Rep develops phased delivery schedule with contractor: project phases (foundation → framing → electrical → finishing), material quantities per phase, delivery dates aligned with construction timeline
Supply Planning reserves inventory for phased deliveries: sets aside materials for future phases; adjusts ROP and safety stock for high-demand project SKUs
Logistics Coordinator manages ongoing phased delivery calendar: confirms dates 3 days before each phase, adjusts for construction delays; system tracks completion against plan

steps.activity: Trade Sales Rep receives urgent request: critical material needed same-day; verifies availability; Store Manager approves emergency prioritization

Driver executes same-day delivery; contractor signs receipt; Store Manager tracks emergency frequency per contractor; Trade Sales Rep follows up on additional needs

steps.activity: Logistics Coordinator verifies job site access: gate location, security clearance, vehicle restrictions, unloading area; for Metro Manila: checks LGU truck ban hours (6–9AM and 4–8PM)
Coordinator arranges special access if needed: LGU delivery permit, barangay clearance, temporary road closure coordination, security guard notification
Driver confirms site access upon arrival; if denied: contacts Logistics Coordinator for alternative; documents access issues for future planning
